info.title: TruVerifAI External API V1
info.description:
Multi-model verification by API. Run any prompt through GPT, Claude,
Gemini, and Grok in parallel, then synthesize a single answer with
sources, conflicts, and confidence — depending on the mode you pick.

Three modes:
  - **unify** (~1 credit) — fast synthesis across all four providers
  - **justify** (~2.5 credits) — multi-round deliberation that
    surfaces real disagreement
  - **verify** (~5 credits) — full claim extraction with web-grounded
    per-claim verdicts

The 1 / 2.5 / 5 baselines assume Standard-tier models across all
four families. Actual credits charged per query are derived from
measured provider cost + a fixed margin (Credit System v2) — call
`POST /v1/estimate-cost` for a pre-flight estimate of the current
selection.

Auth: Bearer token (`tvai_…`). Get a key at
`https://truverif.ai/settings/api-keys`.

post.description:
Returns 202 with a `request_id`. The job runs asynchronously
(10s–5min depending on mode). Two ways to retrieve the result:

- **Polling** — `GET /v1/queries/{id}` every 5–10 seconds until
  `status == "completed"`. Recommended cadence: 5s for the
  first 60s, then 10s.
- **SSE** — `GET /v1/queries/{id}/stream` to receive
  `progress` events plus a final `result`.

### Idempotency

Pass an `Idempotency-Key` header (any unique string ≤ 200 chars)
to make submission idempotent. Replays within 24h with the same
body return the original `request_id` with
`idempotent_replayed: true`. Replays with a different body
return 409 `idempotency_conflict`.

### Restart caveat (V1)

In V1, in-flight jobs live in process memory. If the worker
restarts mid-run, polling returns 404. Retry with the same
`Idempotency-Key` — the next submit will re-enqueue without
double-charging credits. We're migrating to durable queues
post-V1; until then, set client retry policy on 404.

value.prompt: What is the capital of France?

verify_with_web.summary: Verify mode with explicit web-search preference

with_files.summary: Verify mode with a PDF attachment

value.prompt: Verify the claims in this report.

with_byom.summary: 3 first-party + 1 BYOM (4 participants, the per-query max)

value.prompt: Compare the defaults with our fine-tuned model.

202.description: Job accepted; poll or stream for the result.

get.summary: Get the result of a submitted query
get.description:
Returns one of:

- **200** with `status: "queued"` or `status: "running"` while
  the job is in flight. Repeat until `status == "completed"`.
- **200** with `status: "completed"` and the full response body
  once the job finishes.
- **200** with `status: "failed"` and an `error` block if the
  aggregation pipeline raised. Don't retry on this — the
  underlying problem won't fix itself.
- **404** if the `request_id` isn't found (expired or worker
  restart — see Idempotency on POST).

200.description: Query result (status varies — check the `status` field).

get.summary: Stream the result via Server-Sent Events
get.description:
Opens a long-lived SSE connection. Emits `progress` events while
the job is running and a final `result` event when complete (or
an `error` event on failure). The connection closes after the
terminal event.

### Event types

- `progress` — payload `{stage, message, percent, eta}`
- `result` — payload is the same shape as
  `GET /v1/queries/{id}` returns at status=completed
- `error` — payload `{error: {...}}` matching the V1 error
  envelope

Reconnection is a manual concern — re-issuing this endpoint
with the same `request_id` is safe; you'll get only `result`
or `error` if the job is already done.

403.description:
The stream belongs to a different API key (`permission_denied`).
A not-found request is delivered as an in-stream `error` event on
an open 200 stream rather than an HTTP error.

get.summary: List available models grouped by provider
get.description:
Returns the catalog of models the API can select from. Group
keys are public provider names (`openai`, `anthropic`, `google`,
`xai`); each group is an ordered array of models.

Each model lists its `model_id` (the value to pass in the
`models` field on `POST /v1/queries`), pricing per million
tokens, and a `tier` hint (`budget`, `standard`, `premium`).

post.summary: Pre-flight credit estimate for a hypothetical query
post.description:
Returns per-mode credit estimates for the caller's model
selection, plus a `can_afford` pre-flight against the tier
balance. Mirrors the Credit Cost Preview surfaced on the web
`/models` page.

The numbers are estimates — actual credit deduction is post-hoc
cost+ from `provider_call_log` data, so real credits charged
may differ in either direction. The response always carries a
`disclaimer` field explaining the variance.

Use this endpoint to:
- show "this would cost ~X credits" pre-submit UIs
- check `can_afford` before submitting a query
- illustrate how switching models / modes changes the estimate
  (the response includes all three modes' estimates, not just
  the one requested)

mode.description:
The mode to gate-check with `can_afford` /
`reservation_credits`. The response also includes
estimates for the other two modes under
`credits_by_mode`.

models.description:
Same shape as the field on `POST /v1/queries`.
When supplied, the preview reflects this selection
instead of the user's saved defaults. Pass
`null` for a family to exclude it from the preview.

custom_models.description:
BYOM ids that would participate. Echoed back in the
response; BYOMs are zero variable cost so they do
not change the per-mode estimate.

default.summary: Estimate for Verify with the user's default models

reservation_credits.description:
Per-mode credit estimate for `requested_mode`.
Same value as `credits_by_mode[mode]`. Echoed at
the top level for callers that only care about
one mode.

credits_by_mode.description:
Per-mode estimates for all three modes — lets the
caller render "switching to Verify would cost X
more" UI without a second round-trip.

model_multiplier.description:
Display-only — the selected-set credit ratio
relative to the four default Standard-tier models.
`1.0` means the selection has identical cost to
the defaults; `>1.0` means more expensive.

selected_models.description:
Echo of which models the preview was computed
against. Includes a `custom` array when
`custom_models` was supplied in the request.

can_afford.description:
True when the user has enough remaining credits
AND is within their monthly tier ceiling /
spend-cap for the requested mode.

disclaimer.description:
Plain-English variance explanation. Surface this
verbatim alongside any credit estimate.

200.description: Tier, allotment, used, remaining, mode weights.

schema.description:
Usage snapshot for the key's owner. Fields vary by tier and
account state; the stable ones are below and the object may
carry additional fields.

get.description:
Paginated list of `QueryCost` rows. Cursor pagination via
`cursor` (an ISO-8601 timestamp from a prior response's
`next_cursor`). `format=csv` returns a downloadable CSV
attachment; pagination is disabled in CSV mode (max 5000 rows).

schema.description:
CSV with columns: timestamp / mode / fingerprint /
credits_charged / file_attached / file_category /
success.

post.description:
Multipart upload. Returns a `file_id` you can pass to
`POST /v1/queries` via the `files` array.

Supported categories (per provider capability matrix):
  - **Images** PNG / JPG / GIF / WEBP — max 20 MB
  - **PDF** — max 32 MB
  - **Documents** DOC / DOCX — max 32 MB
  - **Code** py / js / ts / html / css / json / yaml / sql — max 10 MB

Per-request: max 5 files, 30 MB combined size.

get.summary: Audit log scoped to the calling key
get.description:
Tamper-evident log of every authenticated call (and every failed
auth attempt) made with this key. Cursor pagination; pass
`format=csv` for a downloadable CSV.

BearerAuth.description:
`Authorization: Bearer tvai_…`. Get a key at
`https://truverif.ai/settings/api-keys`. Treat keys like
passwords — they're shown exactly once at creation.

IdempotencyKey.name: Idempotency-Key
IdempotencyKey.description:
Any unique string ≤ 200 chars. Replays within 24h with the same
body return the original `request_id` with
`idempotent_replayed: true`. Different body with the same key
returns 409 `idempotency_conflict`.

Mode.description:
- **unify** (~1 credit) — single-pass synthesis across all four
  providers
- **justify** (~2.5 credits) — multi-round deliberation
- **verify** (~5 credits) — claim extraction + web verification

Baselines assume Standard-tier models across all four families.
Actual credits charged depend on query complexity, model
selection, and web-search activity (Credit System v2 cost+).
Call `POST /v1/estimate-cost` for a pre-flight estimate.

Provider.description:
Public provider identifier. `custom` indicates a Bring-Your-Own-Model
(BYOM) participant — when this value appears, the same response
object carries a `custom_model` field echoing the `byom_<id>` the
caller passed in `custom_models`.

QueryRequest.description:
Submission payload for `POST /v1/queries`. A single query may
have at most **4 participants** total — first-party providers
(`models`) + BYOMs (`custom_models`) combined. The synthesizer
was tuned for ≤4 inputs; requests exceeding the cap return 400
with `error.code = "invalid_request"`. Override via the
`PARTICIPANT_CAP` env var server-side.

prompt.description: User prompt. 32 KB ceiling enforced server-side.

models.description:
Optional per-provider model selection. Only the providers you
list run: pass a `model_id` (string) to use that specific model,
or `null` to skip the provider. Omitting a provider inside this
object also skips it. Omit the entire `models` field to fall
back to the user's default selection.

Example: `{"openai": "gpt-5.4-2026-03-05", "anthropic": null,
"google": null, "xai": null}` runs only OpenAI.

custom_models.description:
Add Bring-Your-Own-Model participants to the deliberation.
Each entry is a `byom_<id>` string — the same ids returned in
the `custom` group of `GET /v1/models`. The BYOM must be
active and owned by the calling API key's user.

Pair with `models: {openai: null, anthropic: null, google: null,
xai: null}` for a BYOM-only query.

web_search.description:
Accepted on all three modes. `auto` defers to the engine's
heuristic, `always` forces web search, `never` disables it.
Verify additionally runs web search as part of fact-checking;
for Verify, `mode_options.verify_with_web` overrides this field.

mode_options.description:
Mode-specific options. Currently: `verify_with_web`
(`auto` / `always` / `never`) for Verify mode, which overrides
the top-level `web_search`.

aggregation_model.description:
Optional synthesizer override — the model that merges the
panel's responses into the final answer. A first-party catalog
`model_id`, or a `byom_<id>` for a Bring-Your-Own-Model
synthesizer. Defaults to the account's configured synthesizer.

metadata.description:
Free-form key/value bag echoed back in
response.metadata.metadata. Use for your own tracing.

estimated_credits.description:
Estimated credit cost for this query. Present on a fresh
submission; omitted on an idempotency replay.

idempotent_replayed.description:
Present and `true` only when this 202 was served from the
idempotency cache (a replay). Absent on a fresh submission.

error.description: Present only on a failed poll response (status failed).

custom_model.description:
Present only when `provider == "custom"`. Echoes the
`byom_<id>` the caller passed in `custom_models`, so
responses can be mapped back to the BYOM that produced
them.

skipped_models.description:
Preselected BYOMs dropped from this query's fan-out because they
were inactive (kill-switched) or could not be found (deleted /
not owned). Present only when the request omitted `custom_models`
(so the saved preselection was used) AND at least one preselected
BYOM was dropped — omitted entirely otherwise.

model.description: The `byom_<id>` identifier from the saved preselection.

reason.description:
`inactive` — the BYOM is kill-switched; re-test it to
re-enable. `not_found` — it was deleted or isn't owned by
this account; remove it from the saved preselection.

usage.description:
Credits actually charged for this query under the Credit
System v2 cost-plus formula. V1 multi-axis fields
(`mode_weight`, `model_multiplier`, `file_multiplier`) were
removed when V2 shipped — credits are now derived from
measured provider cost + a fixed margin, not a multiplier
stack.

sources.description: Raw engine source objects (shape passed through untransformed).

custom.description:
The calling API key's active BYOMs. Pass any `id` from this
list to `POST /v1/queries` via `custom_models`. Absent when
the user has no BYOMs configured.

CustomModelInfo.description:
A BYOM (Bring-Your-Own-Model) entry from `GET /v1/models`'s
`custom` group. `id` is the value to pass in `custom_models` on
`POST /v1/queries`. The `model_id` and `wire_protocol` fields
are echoed from the BYOM's setup for informational purposes —
the request only needs the `id`.

wire_protocol.description: The wire protocol the BYOM uses to talk to its host.

QueryCostRow.description:
One row of per-query usage history. V2-aligned shape — V1
multi-axis multipliers and the raw cost surface
(`estimated_cost_usd`, `tavily_searches`, `perplexity_calls`)
are no longer exposed; `credits_charged` is the only price
field.

event_type.description: See the event_type query param for the full enum.

retriable.description:
True for 5xx and 429. False for 4xx (which means fix
the request, don't retry it).

Forbidden.description:
Authenticated but the action isn't permitted (key suspended,
AUP not yet accepted, etc.).

InsufficientCredits.description: Tier allotment exhausted, or per-key monthly spend cap exceeded.

IdempotencyConflict.description: Same Idempotency-Key with a different body within the 24h TTL.

RateLimited.description:
Up to 8 concurrent in-flight queries per API key; submitting while at
the cap returns 429 `rate_limited`. There is no fixed per-minute
request cap — the effective ceiling is the account's credit balance.
Honor the `Retry-After` header.
